observations: Photo 0 shows a car gearbox/transmission assembly on the ground with wiring/hoses attached; no clear make/model markings visible.
Photo 0 shows the bellhousing area and internal clutch/torque-converter-looking components; condition appears used with dust/debris.
Photo 1 shows the same transmission/gearbox from another angle; multiple hydraulic lines/wiring harnesses are visible.
No visible label/part number/vehicle VIN plate in either photo; brand/model cannot be read.

claims.claim: Direct tokunbo Japan highest grade Rogue and Altima gearbox
claims.evidence: Neither photo shows a readable Nissan Rogue/Altima identification, part number, or label tying the gearbox to those models.

risks.risk: Wrong fitment/model (Rogue vs Altima vs other Nissan) or wrong transmission type (CVT/AT/MT) leading to incompatibility.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the transmission ID/part number label (or stamped code) and the gearbox type tag, plus the vehicle it came from (year/model/engine) shown in one frame.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used gearbox with unknown fitment/type (worst-case: may not fit or may not be the correct transmission).

risks.risk: Unknown working condition (may be faulty, slipping, leaking, or incomplete). Photos only show the unit, not operation.
risks.proof: Video of the gearbox being tested (bench test or installed test) showing it engages all gears/drive and no abnormal noise, plus a leak check.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working (worst-case: treat as needing overhaul/repair).

risks.risk: Missing components or damage not visible (mounts, sensors, solenoids, harness connectors, cooler lines, torque converter/valve body parts).
risks.proof: Photo checklist: all external sensors/solenoids, connectors, mounting points, and any included parts laid out; close-ups of harness connectors and ports.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially incomplete/with missing parts (worst-case: buyer may need to source missing items).

risks.risk: Fluid contamination or internal wear (cannot be assessed from exterior photos).
risks.proof: Photo of dipstick/fill port condition (if applicable) and confirmation of fluid type/condition; ideally a short test report from the workshop.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown internal condition (worst-case: assume heavy wear/needs service).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photos of any transmission ID/part number label or stamped code (must be readable).
Photo showing the gearbox type (e.g., CVT/AT/MT) from labels or markings, not just appearance.
Video proof of operation/testing (engagement and no abnormal noise), or a receipt/test report from the workshop.
Photos of all included parts: sensors/solenoids/harness connectors/mounting brackets/hoses/cooler lines; confirm nothing is missing.
response.reason: The photos show a used gearbox/transmission assembly, but there is no readable identification to confirm it is specifically for Nissan Rogue/Altima or even the correct transmission type, and the working condition is not provable from images alone. Without those proofs, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
